chunks: 4398 — Abū Ṭālib, may Allah have mercy on him, delivered a speech when the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله married Khadījah bint Khuwaylid, may Allah have mercy on her, after he had proposed for her to her father, and some people say to her uncle. So he took hold of the two doorposts, while those of Quraysh who witnessed him were present, and he said:
All praise belongs to Allah, who made us from the offspring of Ibrāhīm and the descendants of Ismāʿīl, and made for us a House visited in pilgrimage.
and a secure sanctuary to which the fruits of all things are brought.

And He made us rulers over the people in our land in which we are. Then indeed my nephew Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib is not weighed against any man of Quraysh except that he outweighs him, nor is he compared with any of them except that he is greater than him. Even if he has little wealth, wealth is passing provision and a vanishing shade. He has desire for Khadījah, and she has desire for him. The dowry—its immediate and deferred portions, whatever you ask—shall be from my wealth. And he possesses immense worth, lofty rank, and an eloquent, weighty tongue.
So he married her to him, and he consummated the marriage with her the following day. The first child she bore was ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله.

key_terms.بَيْتًا مَحْجُوجًا: the Sacred House frequented for hajj (pilgrimage)
key_terms.خَطَبَ: delivered a formal address or sermon
key_terms.زَرْعِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: the offspring or progeny of Ibrāhīm
key_terms.شَأْنٌ رَفِيعٌ: an exalted standing and high rank

ai.seo_question: What did Abū Ṭālib say in the marriage sermon for the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and Khadījah?
ai.summary: This report narrates the marriage of the Prophet Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله to Khadījah bint Khuwaylid, with Abū Ṭālib publicly praising Allah and extolling the Prophet’s lineage, merit, and rank. It also records his offer to provide the dowry and presents this marriage as a noble and honored union.
